name: brawlNewCreaturesPackObjects
description:
Modified NewCreaturesPack mod and core objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps:
Pyramid: 8 Diamond Golems and 2x 2 Invisible Men, reward unchanged,
Quark Palace: 7x 1 Invisible Man, reward: 1 Invisible Man, 1500 Gold.
All creatures in each bank that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
author: Warzyw647

1.0: moved Pyramid and Quark Palace to a separate submod from brawlObjects
smaller Pyramid, uses Invisible Man from Invisible Man mod
smaller Quark Palace from mod Invisible Man
